subject: general
question: Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group? (Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Option 1) AB - GH**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba3fdbbc0681a8f3dc0af720883c052029b0215932112f29b0748bd9b0a4b620.png] 

 

**Option 2) IJ - OP**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb88b5aa9ad9f49b66a641a252d470bc4657ee56311c11601a3ef26250ed009d.png] 

 

**Option 3) MN - SV**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/afeb0d03e9015c5dcee4cbf82d4450ef27498aec19bff57df4abce878d4871ab.png] 

The logic is not followed here as the shifts are +6 and +8.

**Option 4) QR - WX**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c39754d92f85fa8321780dd8c69dc7afc1f7aae790f0dbb4f7d4c776448195c0.png] 

 

Thus, **MN - SV** is the odd one out as it does not follow the logic.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
